restaurant_name: Dr.Worawut Clinic คลินิก หมอวรวุฒิ
text:
Received my 4th injection of rabies vaccine (Verorab brand)

Total cost 700 baht

Dr speaks good English. Very professional.

Opens 5:00 p.m. - closes 7:00 p.m.

Arrived 4:45 as the second person in line

Finished by 5:30 and there were more than 40 people waiting

NOTE 🎵 Since I'm traveling I got my injections at different hospitals. He said you should only take one brand. If you change the brand, it's okay but you can only do it one time.

He said that if you get in contact with rabies again within 6 months, you need a single injection of booster

6 months - 5 years you need two injections of booster

I hope this information helps you! 🙏
